location.title: Location
location.caption: Sunrise/sunset for outdoor lighting is computed locally from these coordinates — no internet needed. Search a place, click the map, or enter coordinates by hand.
location.noResults: Nothing found (search needs an internet connection — you can still enter coordinates below).
location.label: Label

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.caption: Feeds the Calendar sensor: which weekdays are the weekend and which dates are holidays. Both work offline; the import only pre-fills holidays when online.

backups.title: Backups
backups.caption: A full home backup in one archive: devices, rules, history, ML models, dashboards and plugin settings. Restoring returns the home to the bundle's state and restarts the services. The Zigbee radio network (coordinator) is backed up separately — see the documentation.
backups.uploaded: Bundle uploaded: {{file}}. You can now restore it from the list.
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore the home from {{file}}? Current data will be replaced and all services will restart.
backups.busy: A backup or restore is already running — try again shortly.

whoami.title: Who is at this device
whoami.caption: For the activity log: commands from this browser will be attributed to the selected resident. This is not a login — real authentication comes in Phase 3.
whoami.label: User

intelligence.title: Intelligence layer
intelligence.caption: Control learning, model-driven governance and proactive suggestions.
intelligence.enabledHint: Off pauses everything: training, model-driven control (governors fall back to Shadow) and all suggestions. Nothing is lost — turn it back on to resume.
intelligence.proposalsHint: Off keeps learning and control running but stops the system proposing new rules, scenes and models on its own. The manual scan buttons still work.
intelligence.minHistoryDaysHint: On a fresh install the suggesters stay quiet until this much history has accrued — the ML page shows the progress.
